title: Welcome, Commander, to Crownspire!
body:
Welcome to your new Citadel! As Lord of the Crownspire, you are charged with defending the realm against the invading Wildling hordes and securing the Crystallite Spire. Use these starter resources to lay the foundations of your empire.

May light guide your blade!

title: Server Maintenance Compensation
body: Greetings, Commander. The Citadel underwent a scheduled database synchronization and upgrade to Version 1.4.2. We apologize for any temporary inconvenience this downtime caused your legions. Please accept this compensation package.

title: RE: Missing Gathering Materials
body:
Commander, I have reviewed your petition regarding the uncounted Iron Ore from your gathering march on Jul 2nd.
Our scribes confirmed a momentary latency spike in the local server cluster during your troops' return. The materials have been restored to your supply log. We appreciate your patience.

title: VIP Club Status Update
body:
Congratulations, Lord Aurelius! Your continuous support has elevated your Citadel to VIP level 5. This grants you a permanent passive production boost of +10% on food and +5% troop training speeds.
Claim your weekly VIP prestige tokens below.
